label: Aqueduct · Ilan–Amit 1989

features.label: Visible channel start · Ilan point 3
features.description: Best functional match for the head of the whole aqueduct. Located at a small ravine on the northern bank.
features.limit: No particular great stone identified. A northern bank does not resolve the wording’s grammatical ambiguity.

features.label: Branch junction and short western tunnel
features.description: Possible beginning of a collecting branch or subsection. Short tunnel probably corresponds to Reeder Tunnel 2.
features.limit: Needs a subsection-head reading. Branch function and flow direction differ among published interpretations.

features.label: Long eastern tunnel · western mouth
features.description: Reeder Fig. 2 and Magen Fig. 87 visually match the same long-tunnel mouth. Magen’s text supports its western/upstream attribution; Ilan point 11 and Reeder Tunnel 1 remain probable plan correspondences. Davey CJD979 supplies a matching 1974 view of this mouth.
features.limit: Downstream of the intake. Reeder calls the photo an exit and Magen an entrance; the visual match itself establishes neither hydraulic direction nor a scroll identity.
sources: Christopher Davey 1974, CJD979, DQCAAS photographic archive

features.label: Basin 2

features.limit: Its association with the named reservoir in entry 22 is conditional. No mapped fissure or geographic registration is established.

features.label: Proposed dam · point 4
features.description: A proposed lost dam alongside basin 2 in the source plan.
features.limit: Its existence and ancient phase are unresolved. The dam/cairn reading remains disputed.
